title: 租房子
summary: Finding a place near campus as a student.
paragraphs: 來臺灣念書以後，我要在學校附近租房子。
我在網路上找了很多房子，也去看了幾間。
有的房間很便宜，可是太小了；有的又大又漂亮，可是房租太貴。
最後，我找到一間雅房，房東人很好，一個月八千塊，水電費另外算。
雖然要和別人共用浴室，但是離學校很近，走路只要五分鐘。
搬家那天，室友還請我吃了一頓晚飯。
translation: After coming to Taiwan to study, I needed to rent a place near school.
I looked at lots of places online and went to see a few.
Some rooms were cheap but too small; some were big and nice but the rent was too high.
In the end I found a room with a shared bathroom. The landlord is nice: eight thousand a month, utilities extra.
I have to share the bathroom, but it's close to school, only five minutes on foot.
On moving day, my roommate even treated me to dinner.
